name: Data Analytics
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)

beginner.summary: For new analysts and business staff moving into analysis. Covers the analysis process, data types and quality, spreadsheet analysis, pivot tables, charts, SQL queries and joins, data cleaning, descriptive statistics, pandas, visualisation in Python, a first Power BI report, business questions, KPIs, storytelling and data ethics.
prerequisites: Comfortable with Excel at a basic level: entering data, simple formulas and charts
Basic school mathematics: percentages and averages
outcomes: Clean, summarise and chart data in Excel, SQL and Python
Answer business questions with clear metrics
Build a simple Power BI report
Present findings as a short, accurate story

days.topic: Data Analytics Overview and Tool Setup
subtopics: What data analysts do day to day
Descriptive, diagnostic, predictive and prescriptive analytics
The analysis process: ask, prepare, process, analyse, share, act
Roles: analyst, data engineer, data scientist and BI developer
Installing PostgreSQL and a SQL client
Power BI Desktop and Tableau Public
Course datasets: sales, customers and web events
days.lab_task: Install the course tools, load the sales dataset into PostgreSQL, open it in Excel and in a Jupyter notebook, and write one business question you will answer by the end of the course.
days.deliverable: Working tool set-up screenshots, project folder and a written business question
checks: Run SELECT COUNT(*) on the sales table
Row count matches the source file
First five rows shown with pandas
Specific and answerable with the data

days.topic: Types of Data and Data Quality
subtopics: Numeric, categorical, date and text fields
Data quality dimensions: accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness
days.lab_task: Profile the customer dataset: classify each column, state what one row represents, record quality problems by dimension and write a data dictionary.
days.deliverable: Profile sheet and data dictionary
checks: At least five problems each tied to a dimension
Every column defined with type and meaning

days.topic: Spreadsheet Analysis: Sorting, Filtering and Formulas
days.lab_task: Convert the sales data to an Excel table, calculate revenue by region and month with SUMIFS, flag orders above target with IF, and highlight the top 10 percent of orders.
days.deliverable: Workbook with formulas and a findings note
checks: Recalculate a regional total by hand
Absolute references keep the right cells

days.topic: Lookups and Combining Data in Excel
subtopics: Why data is split across tables
Checking row counts after a merge
days.lab_task: Add customer segment and product category to the sales table using XLOOKUP and then rebuild it as a Power Query merge, and explain any rows that fail to match.
days.deliverable: Workbook with both approaches and a match report
checks: Merged table has the same rows as sales
New rows appear without manual work

subtopics: Summarising by sum, count and average
Percent of total and running totals
days.lab_task: Build pivot tables for revenue by category and month, share of revenue by region and average order value by segment, with slicers for year and channel.
days.deliverable: Pivot workbook and three written findings
checks: Each finding supported by a pivot value

subtopics: Choosing the chart for the question
When not to use pie charts
Axis scales and starting at zero
days.lab_task: Create four charts answering four questions about sales, rewrite each title as a finding, then fix three misleading example charts.
days.deliverable: Charts, findings and fixed examples
checks: Each chart type matches its question
Problem named and corrected for each

days.topic: SQL Queries for Analysts: Selecting and Filtering
subtopics: WHERE with comparisons and AND or OR
days.lab_task: Write ten queries against the sales database answering questions such as "orders over 500 in March from the North region", including one that handles missing values correctly.
days.deliverable: SQL file with ten queries and results
checks: Compare a query with the Excel filter
Each query answers its stated question

days.topic: Aggregation and GROUP BY in SQL
subtopics: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX
GROUP BY one or more columns
days.lab_task: Calculate monthly revenue, orders and average order value by region, bucket customers by spend with CASE and list categories with revenue over a threshold using HAVING.
days.deliverable: SQL file and results
checks: Only categories over the threshold returned

subtopics: LEFT JOIN and finding missing matches
days.lab_task: Join orders, customers and products to report revenue by segment and category, find customers with no orders using a LEFT JOIN and fix a join that doubles revenue.
days.deliverable: SQL file, results and a note on the doubling bug
checks: Revenue matches the orders table total

days.topic: Cleaning Data: Missing Values, Duplicates and Formats
subtopics: Deciding to fill, flag or drop
days.lab_task: Clean the messy customer file: fix dates in three formats, standardise country names, remove duplicate customers, decide on each missing value and document every step.
days.deliverable: Cleaned data, cleaning log and before and after counts

days.lab_task: Describe order values by region with mean, median, quartiles and standard deviation, plot histograms and box plots, and explain why mean and median differ.
days.deliverable: Statistics table, charts and explanation
checks: Outliers found with the IQR rule
Comparison uses spread as well as averages

subtopics: Python values, lists and dictionaries in brief
days.lab_task: Load the sales and customer files into pandas, filter, add a margin column, rank products by revenue and save the top 20 to Excel.
days.deliverable: Notebook and output file
checks: Run all cells from the top

days.lab_task: Run an exploratory analysis of web events and sales: merge them, compute monthly conversion by channel, find missing data patterns and list five questions for further analysis.
days.deliverable: Exploration notebook and five questions
checks: Values between 0 and 1 for every channel and month

days.topic: Visualising Data with Matplotlib and Seaborn
days.lab_task: Create a monthly trend chart with annotations, a distribution comparison, a scatter of discount against margin and small multiples by region, using one consistent style.
days.deliverable: Notebook and exported charts

days.topic: Building a First Power BI Report
days.lab_task: Build a one-page sales report with a revenue trend, top products, a region map and slicers for year and channel, then publish it.
days.deliverable: Report file and published link
checks: Most important number at the top left

subtopics: From vague requests to clear questions
days.lab_task: Interview a role-play stakeholder with a vague request ("sales are down, find out why"), turn it into three specific questions with hypotheses and data needs, and agree the scope.
days.deliverable: Interview notes and an analysis brief
checks: Each can be confirmed or rejected with data

days.lab_task: Build a metric tree for revenue, define five KPIs precisely (formula, filters, grain, owner) and calculate them for the last two quarters.
days.deliverable: Metric tree, definitions and calculated values
checks: Formula, filters and grain stated for each

days.lab_task: Turn the sales analysis into a five-slide story with one main message, three charts and two recommendations, present it in five minutes and answer questions.
days.deliverable: Slides and presentation recording
checks: Main message stated in one sentence

days.topic: Data Privacy and Ethics for Analysts
subtopics: GDPR and India's DPDP Act in brief
What to do when asked to mislead
days.lab_task: Review a customer dataset for personal data, pseudonymise it for analysis, identify a bias risk in a proposed analysis and respond to a case where a manager asks you to hide a bad result.
days.deliverable: Privacy review, pseudonymised dataset and case response
checks: Honest response with a clear escalation path

subtopics: Cleaning and analysis in SQL and Python
days.lab_task: Answer the business question from day one: write a brief, clean the data, analyse it in SQL and pandas, build a Power BI report and present a five-minute data story with recommendations.
days.deliverable: Brief, SQL and notebook, report and presentation
checks: SQL, pandas and Power BI totals match
Main message, evidence and recommendations clear
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one analysis
Answer a business question end to end

intermediate.summary: For working analysts. Covers advanced SQL, dimensional models, larger data wrangling, time series, cohort, funnel and A/B test analysis, hypothesis testing, regression, segmentation, Tableau dashboards, DAX measures, dashboard design, report automation, APIs, data quality checks, forecasting, cloud warehouses and communicating insights.
prerequisites: Writes SQL with joins and GROUP BY
Uses pandas or Power BI for analysis
Has delivered at least one analysis to a stakeholder
outcomes: Answer product, customer and marketing questions with cohort, funnel and experiment analysis
Use statistics correctly to support decisions
Build dashboards in Tableau and Power BI that people use
Automate recurring analysis and check data quality

days.topic: Advanced SQL: Window Functions and CTEs
days.lab_task: Use CTEs and window functions to find the top three products per region, month-over-month revenue change, a seven-day moving average and each customer's longest streak of weekly orders.
days.deliverable: SQL file and results
checks: CTEs named clearly and each does one thing

days.topic: Data Modelling for Analysis: Star Schemas
subtopics: Modelling in Power BI and Tableau
days.lab_task: Design a star schema for sales with a date dimension and a type 2 customer dimension, build it in PostgreSQL and point a Power BI model at it.
days.deliverable: Model diagram, SQL scripts and Power BI model
checks: One sentence that matches the table

days.topic: Data Wrangling at Scale with pandas
days.lab_task: Process a 5-million-row event file: reduce memory with correct types, reshape it, convert it to Parquet and compare run time in pandas and Polars.
days.deliverable: Notebook and timing comparison
checks: At least 50 percent lower after type changes

subtopics: Time series components: trend, seasonality and noise
days.lab_task: Analyse two years of daily orders: decompose trend and seasonality, compare year over year adjusting for festivals and flag anomalies with a rolling rule.
days.deliverable: Notebook with decomposition, comparisons and anomaly list
checks: Each anomaly explained or flagged for review

days.lab_task: Build monthly acquisition cohorts in SQL, calculate retention for 12 months, plot a heatmap and explain which cohorts retain best and why.
days.deliverable: SQL, heatmap and findings
checks: Retention is 100 percent for every cohort

days.lab_task: Build a sign-up to purchase funnel from raw web events in SQL, segment it by device and channel, find the biggest drop-off and suggest a test to improve it.
days.deliverable: Funnel query, chart and recommendation
checks: Each step is at most the step before

days.lab_task: Analyse an A/B test on a checkout change: check for sample ratio mismatch, calculate lift with a confidence interval, check guardrail metrics and write a decision memo.
days.deliverable: Analysis notebook and decision memo
checks: Mismatch tested with a chi-square test
Lift with a 95 percent confidence interval
Decision follows from the result and guardrails

days.lab_task: Test three business claims (a region has higher order values, a promotion changed conversion, delivery time differs by courier) with the right test for each and explain results in plain language.
days.deliverable: Notebook and plain-language explanations
checks: Correct test for each data type
Effect size stated for each test

days.lab_task: Model weekly sales from price, promotion and season with multiple regression, check residuals, explain the price coefficient and list what the model cannot tell you.
days.deliverable: Notebook and explanation for stakeholders
checks: At least two causal limits stated

days.lab_task: Build RFM scores, cluster customers with k-means, choose the number of clusters, profile and name each segment and suggest an action for each.
days.deliverable: Notebook, segment profiles and action list
checks: Each named with its key numbers

days.lab_task: Build a Tableau dashboard of customer retention with a parameter for cohort size, an LOD expression for first purchase date, filter actions between views and publish it.
days.deliverable: Workbook and published dashboard
checks: LOD result matches SQL for three customers

days.lab_task: Add DAX measures for revenue, margin percentage, year-to-date, year-over-year growth and product rank, plus a what-if discount parameter, and check each against SQL.
days.deliverable: Power BI file and a measure check table

subtopics: Who uses the dashboard and why
days.lab_task: Redesign a cluttered operational dashboard after interviewing two users, test the new version with them on three tasks and compare task times.
days.deliverable: Before and after dashboards and user test results
checks: Tasks faster on the new version

days.lab_task: Turn a weekly Excel report built by hand into a scheduled Python job that queries the database, writes a formatted workbook, emails it and alerts on failure.
days.deliverable: Script, schedule configuration and sample output
checks: Run the job for a past week

days.topic: Working with APIs and Web Data
days.lab_task: Pull exchange rates and weather data from public APIs, handle pagination and rate limits, join them to sales and check whether weather explains daily sales changes.
days.deliverable: Notebook, stored data and findings
checks: Record count matches the API total

days.lab_task: Add data quality checks to the sales tables for freshness, row counts, unique IDs, valid ranges and reconciliation with finance totals, and alert on failure.
days.deliverable: Check suite, results report and an alert
checks: Load a file with duplicate IDs

subtopics: Train and test splits for time series
days.lab_task: Forecast the next 12 weeks of orders with a seasonal naive baseline and exponential smoothing, compare errors on a holdout, add intervals and explain the forecast to a planner.
days.deliverable: Notebook, forecast chart and explanation
checks: Error on holdout reported for both

days.topic: Analytics in Cloud Warehouses: BigQuery and Snowflake
days.lab_task: Load the sales data into BigQuery and Snowflake trial accounts, run the cohort query on both, reduce scanned data with partitioning or clustering and connect Power BI.
days.deliverable: Load scripts, query costs before and after and a connected report

days.lab_task: Write a one-page memo from the funnel analysis with a recommendation, present it to a role-play sceptical product manager and agree how to measure the result.
days.deliverable: Memo, presentation notes and agreed measure
checks: Recommendation and evidence in the first paragraph
Answer uses evidence and acknowledges limits

days.lab_task: Investigate why retention fell: build cohorts and funnels, analyse a past experiment, segment customers, publish a dashboard with data quality checks and automated refresh, and present recommendations.
days.deliverable: Analysis notebooks, dashboard, quality checks and presentation
checks: Supported by cohort and funnel evidence
Each has a measure and owner
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one investigation
Explain a business change with evidence

advanced.summary: For senior analysts and analytics leads. Covers analytics engineering with dbt, semantic layers, causal inference, advanced experimentation, marketing attribution, product, pricing, operations and financial analytics, predictive models, advanced forecasting, geospatial and text analytics, Spark SQL, governed self-service, privacy, AI assistants and building an analytics function.
prerequisites: Several years of analysis experience with SQL and Python
Has analysed experiments and built dashboards used by others
outcomes: Build trusted, governed analytics with dbt and semantic models
Estimate causal effects and run advanced experiments
Lead domain analytics for marketing, product, pricing, operations and finance
Set up and lead an analytics function

days.lab_task: Rebuild the sales marts as a dbt project with layered models, tests, documentation, an incremental events model and a snapshot, and run it in CI on every pull request.
days.deliverable: dbt project, docs site and CI run
checks: Lineage shown from sources to marts

subtopics: Power BI semantic models as a shared source
days.lab_task: Define revenue, active customers and retention once in a semantic layer, query them from two tools and prove both show the same numbers.
days.deliverable: Metric definitions and consistency test results

days.lab_task: Estimate the effect of a loyalty programme launched in some cities with difference in differences, check parallel trends, repeat with propensity matching and compare the two estimates.
days.deliverable: Causal diagram, two estimates and assumption checks
checks: Both reported with intervals and the difference explained

days.topic: Advanced Experimentation: Power, Sequential Testing and Variance Reduction
days.lab_task: Plan an experiment with a power analysis, apply CUPED to past data to show the reduced sample size, analyse with a sequential method and set up a long-term holdout.
days.deliverable: Experiment plan, CUPED analysis and holdout design
checks: Sample size for the target effect stated

subtopics: Customer acquisition cost and lifetime value
days.lab_task: Compare last-click and multi-touch attribution on journey data, build a simple marketing mix model and recommend a budget shift with its expected effect.
days.deliverable: Attribution comparison, model and budget recommendation
checks: Shift and expected effect stated with uncertainty

days.lab_task: Write a tracking plan for a new feature, measure its adoption and its effect on retention from event data and present findings to a role-play product team.
days.deliverable: Tracking plan, analysis and presentation
checks: Retention effect stated with its limits

days.lab_task: Estimate price elasticity for three product groups, build a revenue bridge for last quarter and evaluate whether a promotion paid for itself.
days.deliverable: Elasticity estimates, revenue bridge and promotion review
checks: Value with an interval for each group
Price, volume and mix effects add up to the total change

days.lab_task: Classify products with ABC and XYZ, calculate safety stock for a target service level, analyse supplier lead times and build an operations dashboard.
days.deliverable: Classification, safety stock table, lead time analysis and dashboard

days.lab_task: Build a budget versus actual report with price, volume and cost variances, calculate customer profitability with an allocation method and reconcile totals to the ledger.
days.deliverable: Variance report, profitability analysis and reconciliation

days.topic: Predictive Analytics: Churn and Propensity Models
days.lab_task: Build a churn model with a correct prediction window, check for leakage, compare logistic regression and gradient boosting, choose a threshold based on campaign cost and design a test of the campaign.
days.deliverable: Notebook, model comparison and campaign design
checks: No features from after the prediction date
AUC and precision at the threshold reported

days.topic: Advanced Forecasting with Prophet and Hierarchies
days.lab_task: Forecast demand for 200 products across regions with Prophet and statsforecast, reconcile to regional totals, backtest against a baseline and report forecast value added.
days.deliverable: Forecasting notebook, backtest report and accuracy dashboard
checks: Product forecasts add up to regional totals
Value added calculated for each model

subtopics: Location analytics for stores and delivery
days.lab_task: Geocode customer addresses, calculate drive-distance catchments for stores with PostGIS, map penetration by area and recommend a location for a new store.
days.deliverable: Notebook, maps and recommendation
checks: Each customer assigned to an area

days.lab_task: Analyse 10,000 support tickets: classify themes with topic modelling and with an LLM, check both against 200 human labels and report the top themes by trend.
days.deliverable: Notebook, accuracy comparison and theme report
checks: Personal data removed before sending to the LLM

subtopics: When data outgrows a single machine
days.lab_task: Run the cohort and funnel analyses on 500 million events with Spark SQL, optimise a slow join, and compare cost and run time with the warehouse version.
days.deliverable: Notebook, optimisation notes and cost comparison
checks: Same numbers as the smaller-sample warehouse run

subtopics: Training and support for business users
days.lab_task: Design a self-service model for three departments: certified datasets, workspaces, row-level security and a catalogue, then audit usage and plan retirement of unused reports.
days.deliverable: Governance design, security rules and usage audit
checks: Each department sees only its data

days.lab_task: Assess a customer dataset for re-identification risk, apply aggregation thresholds and k-anonymity to a published report, check a model for unfair outcomes and complete a privacy impact assessment.
days.deliverable: Risk assessment, anonymised report, fairness check and assessment
checks: Each group has at least k records

days.topic: AI Assistants and LLMs in Analytics Work
subtopics: Copilot in Power BI and Excel
days.lab_task: Use an AI assistant to write SQL for ten business questions, check each against your own query, test a natural-language question feature on a semantic model and write team guidelines.
days.deliverable: Accuracy log, evaluation notes and guidelines
checks: Rules for data security and checking

days.topic: Building an Analytics Function: Strategy and Prioritisation
days.lab_task: Design an analytics function for a 2,000-person company: choose the operating model, set up intake and prioritisation, plan a data literacy programme and present a 12-month roadmap.
days.deliverable: Operating model, intake process and roadmap

days.topic: Executive Decision Support and Scenario Modelling
days.lab_task: Build a driver-based model for a market expansion decision with three scenarios, a sensitivity analysis and a Monte Carlo simulation, and present a board-ready recommendation.
days.deliverable: Model, simulation results and board summary

days.lab_task: For a case company, build governed dbt marts and a semantic layer, estimate the causal effect of a past initiative, build a churn model and scenario model for the next initiative, and present an analytics roadmap and recommendation to a leadership panel.
days.deliverable: dbt project, analyses, models, dashboard and leadership presentation
checks: Run dbt build and metric tests
All pass and metrics match across tools
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one programme
